harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 with a persistent firewalld policy permitting SSH and TCP/8080 while rejecting unrelated inbound connections. Verified live behavior before and after reboot. Boot identity changed from 6d37896c-e0cd-4fe7-acbf-94fc35781e09 to fcc432a1-cace-4e78-9ca0-0cd230fe45ca, and the firewall and SSH service recovered successfully.
actions_performed: Enabled persistent SSH and TCP/8080 access in the public zone.
Removed the default Cockpit and DHCPv6-client allowances.
Set the public zone target to REJECT and reloaded firewalld.
Verified SSH and TCP/8080 connectivity and rejection of TCP/8081 using an isolated ingress namespace.
Restarted node1 exactly once and verified its changed boot identity.
Repeated firewall behavior checks after restart and removed all temporary test resources.

evidence.requirement: Persistent host firewall permits only SSH and TCP/8080 with unrelated inbound traffic rejected
evidence.summary: Runtime and permanent public-zone state show SSH, TCP/8080, and an explicit REJECT target. Compiled nftables rules accept ports 22 and 8080 and reject unmatched ingress. firewalld is active and enabled.

evidence.requirement: Direct verification of allowed and rejected inbound behavior
evidence.summary: Before and after restart, isolated ingress received the OpenSSH banner on port 22 and HTTP 200 on port 8080. TCP/8081 could not connect despite a live listener, and no request reached that listener.

Evidence captures the healthy pre-restart boot ID and services, acknowledged safe reboot scheduling, changed post-restart boot ID, recovered firewalld/sshd services, restored runtime and permanent policy, and successful post-restart traffic tests.
